findings.fix: Add a one-line comment at each new `change` documenting which definitional identification it performs, or replace it with a rewrite: line 305 can go through `FDRep.forget₂_ρ` plus the (already-proved) `indFDRep_ρ` and `LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv_apply` instead of raw defeq.
findings.issue: All six `change` steps added by this PR (lines 305, 355, 356, 376, 417, 433) are undocumented, while every pre-existing `change` in this file (110, 120, 130, 165, 173, 410) is preceded by a comment saying why the goal cannot be reached otherwise. Line 305 in particular restates the goal through the unfolding chain `indFDRep → indShrunkFDRep → FDRep.of → conjRingEquiv → forget₂`, i.e. it silently depends on `indFDRep`'s tactic-elaborated body.

findings.evidence: Lines 272-277 and 296-301 are identical modulo the local name `A'`; `Rep.finiteDimensional_ind` at line 236 takes `{k} {G} [Group G] {S} [Field k] [S.FiniteIndex] (A) [FiniteDimensional k A]`, all eight spelled positionally at 274 and 299.

The two copies must elaborate to definitionally identical instances or `indFDRepForgetEquiv` stops typechecking, and the `@`-application with eight positional arguments (including `_` for the explicit `A`) breaks on any binder reordering in `Rep.finiteDimensional_ind`.

findings.issue: `indFDRepMap_id` (348-363), `indFDRepMap_comp` (366-383) and `indFDRepForgetNatIso` (408-422) each repeat the same reasoning — unfold to the conjugated form, then cancel `indFDRepForgetEquiv` against its inverse pointwise via `change ...; ext x; simp`.

summary: The universe split is carried out almost entirely by undocumented `change`/`rfl` steps: every one of the six new `change` uses lacks the explanatory comment the pre-existing ones in this same file carry, and the small-model construction is duplicated verbatim between `indShrunkFDRep` and `indFDRepForgetEquiv` with a fragile `@`-application of `Rep.finiteDimensional_ind`. A `rfl`-lemma isolating the defeq (`indFDRep_ρ`) was added and then never used.
